يمتحنون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَحِنُونَ (yamtaḥinūna) /jam.ta.ħi.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
# يُمْتَحَنُونَ (yumtaḥanūna) /jum.ta.ħa.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَحَنَ (imtaḥana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
